audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text described Galio's level-6 window without naming Hero's Entrance and mislabelled Shield of Durand's role.
audit.why: Riot text: Shield of Durand charges a defensive stance and on release taunts and damages nearby enemies (18/17/16/15/14s). Hero's Entrance is the 4000/4750/5500-range global that shields allies and knocks up on landing (180/160/140s).
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now names Shield of Durand and Hero's Entrance and states the actual 2v1 mechanism.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'he just W-blocks my dash' and 'he can dash-block your engage with W' — Nautilus has no dash; Dredge Line is a projectile pull and Depth Charge is a homing shockwave.
audit.why: Nautilus Q pulls on collision (projectile, 1150 range, 14/13/12/11/10s); R chases the target and cannot be outrun. Galio's dash is Justice Punch (E, 11/10/9/8/7s), which knocks up the first champion hit and, per the missing-interactions file, cuts Nautilus' retreat since he has no dash. Both sides carry displacement, so whoever lands it first owns the trade.
audit.corrected: mid, spikes[2], whys[2] and wants.foe[1] restated with real names and the retreat-cut interaction; dosFull[0].d carries Justice Punch's 11s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Only commit Q when his W is on cooldown' gave no number.
audit.why: Shield of Durand is 18s at rank 1 — the longest punishable window in lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer mentioned that Justice Punch can cut off Nautilus' retreat.
audit.why: Missing-interactions rule 'terrain-cuts-retreat': Galio can cut your retreat with Justice Punch and you have no dash — hold Flash for that, not the damage.

edits.before: From 3 onward this slips out of my hands. Galio's whole kit answers mine: my W and E deal magic damage, which his stacked MR eats, and his W is a damage-reduction taunt that turns my Q engage into a death sentence. At 6 my Depth Charge is single-target lockdown, but he just W-blocks my dash or ults himself out, and his own R lets him peel for an ally or counter-gank me. Only commit Q when his W is on cooldown, otherwise farm and look to roam with R instead of fighting him straight.
edits.after: From 3 onward this slips out of my hands. Galio's whole kit answers mine: my W and E deal magic damage, which his stacked MR eats, and Shield of Durand is a damage-reduction taunt that turns my Q engage into a death sentence. At 6 Depth Charge chases him and cannot be outrun, but Justice Punch cuts my retreat and I have no dash, so Flash is for the wall, not the damage. Only commit Q on the 18-second Shield of Durand cooldown, otherwise farm and roam with R instead of fighting him straight.

edits.after: Galio's R: Shield of Durand taunts you mid-engage, then Hero's Entrance sends him to an ally lane or drops him back onto you, turning your Depth Charge lockdown into a 2v1.

edits.after: Shield of Durand taunts and shields on 18s — he tanks your Q-into-E combo while his already-high MR blunts your magic damage.

edits.after: Bait your Dredge Line, then Shield of Durand taunts you into his minions while shielded
